digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text send path cutover + state-based echo suppression + concurrent-edit safety
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must route description through rich-text codecs (ADF for Cloud, rendered wiki for DC) with state-based echo suppression via baseline comparison, not lossy round-trip idempotence checks

A change-gated inline 8-byte rich_sha digest and reemit counter must bound looping rich-text bodies to one post-push GET at the observe threshold, with baseline advance routed only through _advance_baselines

Two distinct compares must exist: emit-side uses plain inbound-decoded remote vs normalize_outbound(fit_outbound(local)), baseline-side uses decode(baseline_wire) vs normalize_outbound(local) routed through the codec to match decoded baseline

DC create path (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _issues._translate_create_fields) must both compose to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) to render Markdown on create, matching the update path, or newly created issues carry unrendered raw Markdown
Concurrent both-sides body edits must remain local-wins with outbound-field-conflict alert recorded, leaving inbound description additive
The cutover must degrade to plain-text ADF/wiki when marklas/pandoc extras are absent, and is flag-gated OFF by default with independent config read to avoid adapter-layer import inversion
